SELECT 'dup_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(c-1) AS extra FROM (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (
  SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_id', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (
  SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'kuopio_sales_in_refit', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=125 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-15' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_on_closed_days', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE s.store_id<900 AND NOT d.is_trading_day AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'neg_or_zero_qty_lines', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND (f.quantity<=0 OR f.net_amount<=0)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores_current_physical', COUNT(*), NULL FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores_with_multi_current', COUNT(*), NULL FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines_store_999_or_test', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS s, DATE '2026-06-28' AS e),
trading_days AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN (SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d, params p WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND d.is_trading_day) pd
  WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
    AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
    AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
ss AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.v) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n, params p WHERE n.d BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales/td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format, cs.region, td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales/td.trading_days,2) AS per_day,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ss) AS n_ss, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trading_days) AS n_td
FROM ss JOIN trading_days td USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
